name: ollama-token-tracker
description: Ollama token tracker with reliable status-bar icon and accurate final token statistics.

scripts.test: node test/test-stream-parser.js && node test/test-e2e-proxy.js && node test/test-extension-render.js

ollama-tracker.description: Original single-color llama-face glyph used for the Ollama Token Tracker status bar item.

ollamaTokenTracker.proxyPort.description: Port this extension proxy listens on. The universal setup uses Ollama's standard port so all clients are tracked.

ollamaTokenTracker.ollamaUrl.description: URL where the real Ollama server is listening behind the proxy. Default universal backend: http://127.0.0.1:11435.
